data.title: Brookfield Global Infrastructure Securities Income Fund Announces Quarterly Distribution
data.description: In Toronto on September 15, 2026, the Brookfield Global Infrastructure Securities Income Fund (TSX: BGI.UN) disclosed a distribution of C$0.15 per unit for the quarter concluding on September 30, 2026. The distribution is slated for disbursement on or before October 15, 2026, to shareholders recorded as of September 30, 2026.

data.title: A Richardson Staple Returns! Dickey’s Barbecue Pit Reopens Longstanding Location Under New Ownership
data.description: A beloved barbecue restaurant, Dickey’s Barbecue Pit, has reopened its doors at 2160 N. Coit Road in Richardson, TX 75080. This location, situated in the Lennox Center shopping and dining area, has been a staple in the community since 2014, catering to families, students, and local businesses. Known for its slow-smoked meats and warm hospitality, Dickey’s is back to serve its loyal customers in the neighborhood. The reopening took place on September 16, marking a return to the area by bringing back a favorite spot for residents.

data.title: Statement from Leon Black’s Attorneys on Committee on Oversight and Government Reform Mark-up and Contempt Resolution
data.description: Attorneys Susan Estrich of Estrich Goldin and Aaron Cutler of Hogan Lovells Cadwalader, representing Leon Black, submitted letters to Chairman James Comer, Ranking Member Robert Garcia, and the Committee on Oversight and Government Reform in Washington. They criticized the Committee's mark-up and contempt resolution, calling it outrageous. The statement came in response to actions taken by the Committee, led by Chairman James Comer and Ranking Member Robert, without providing specific numbers.

data.title: BIS study highlights significant discrepancies in Bitcoin transfer estimates, posing challenges for tracking economic activity in cryptos.
data.description: A recent study conducted by the Bank for International Settlements revealed that common metrics used in the cryptocurrency industry can sometimes misrepresent actual economic activity. This issue is prevalent across popular cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins. The study highlighted the challenges in accurately measuring and understanding the economic implications of these digital assets.

data.title: Catalyst Acquisition Corp. Announces the Separate Trading of its Class A Ordinary Shares and Rights, Commencing September 17, 2026
data.description: Santa Monica, California, September 15, 2026 - Catalyst Acquisition Corp. (NASDAQ: CATLU) announced that starting September 17, 2026, investors who purchased units in the Company’s initial public offering will have the option to independently trade the Company’s Class A ordinary shares and rights that come with the units. No partial rights will be given upon separation, only complete rights will be tradable. The Class A ordinary shares and rights, once separated, will be listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market with symbols "CATL" and "CATLR" respectively. Units that remain unseparated will still be traded on the Nasdaq Stock Market as "CATLU."

data.title: ComEd, League of Chicago Theatres Award $205,000 in Grants to Support the Arts
data.description: In Chicago, ComEd and the League of Chicago Theatres have revealed the beneficiaries of the 2026 Powering the Arts Grant Program, now in its ninth year. A sum of $205,000 is being distributed among 19 nonprofit organizations throughout northern Illinois. The grants aim to bolster various arts projects, including youth creative programs and community engagement efforts. ComEd expressed pride in collaborating with the League of Chicago Theatres to enhance local arts initiatives.
